versions.changelog:
- Initial release of "cost-effective-life-guide" skill, providing structured, evidence-graded life decision advice across ten major fields and 32 sections.
- Offers 544 actionable recommendations, each including cost, benefit, and evidence strength (A/B/C level, with specific figures and references).
- Designed for targeted queries on health, first aid, money management, legal boundaries, relationships, parenting, career, medical care, studying abroad, and more.
- Emphasizes strict citation of evidence levels, clear cost-benefit structure, and up-to-date policy reminders.
- Built from the HowToLiveBetter open project (GitHub: eternity4719/HowToLiveBetter), referencing the 2026-10-19 PDF version.
